label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Country welcome dialog and privacy dialog both opened at once on arrival, blocking the page until each was closed
A newsletter popup appeared after I closed the other dialogs and blocked my click on a product link; the tree reported it as POPUP Form

Product links are named with a long string ending in Press Enter to show quick view, and the first click only revealed a Quick View button instead of opening the product; a click on that button then timed out

element.name: Seaside [name], Raisin. $128. Press Escape to hide quick view

findings.problem: [name] options are radios named only by colour, one is later renamed out of stock click to view, and size radios have names like Select Size Medium while the visible text is just M, so it is unclear what is chosen
After pressing Continue to Checkout the button became disabled with no message or status, so I could not tell whether anything was loading
